description: Search the named places OrbitStudio can open directly: craters, mountains, valleys, basins and spacecraft landing sites on the Moon and other worlds. Use it when the user names or describes a place to 3D print, or asks what there is on a world. Returns each match's world, coordinates, the size of its box in the app's travel list, a short description and a link that opens the generator at that place.

query.description: Name or part of a name, e.g. 'Tycho', 'Apollo 11', 'Olympus', 'volcano'.

world.description: Which world: moon, mars, mercury, venus, ceres, pluto or charon (only the ones OrbitStudio currently offers are accepted).

name: search_places
title: Search OrbitStudio places
